facts.note: Watches shown when the temple struck nine; Ruedi's exact, Dr Vauthier's two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out.

Hall clock striking ten at regulator 9:48, and the temple's ten agreeing exactly with the regulator, are both present. But the sheet's 'downstairs' location for the hall clock is missing; the transcript says only 'the hall clock struck ten while we were at the bench'.
Sent downstairs at regulator 10:20; regulator running and master well; went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon, master seen in kitchen with Rosa's clock, laughing; she did not ask why.
Looked at Rosa's clock when Madame's piano began: 10:58. When the piano stopped: 11:11.
Stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
